rules.action: Moves through interactive content in reading order: select-all, then per row the checkbox, links, buttons and the actions cell. Cells themselves are not focusable — this is a table, not a grid.
On a sort button, sorts; on a row checkbox, toggles; on a row header button, activates the row.
In `responsive: scroll` below the breakpoint, the scroll region is focusable and arrows scroll it horizontally.
